ns2:course.label: Research Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, on-campus, learning experience with faculty engaged in research. Same as ALEC 294. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated up to 12 hours, if topics vary. Credit is not given for more than a total of 12 hours of Independent Study (IND) courses applying to a degree in ACES. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
